note: Pinned local Jev models. Values come from the Hugging Face API tree listing (lfs.oid is the SHA256) on 2026-10-17. Qwen publishes no GGUF for Qwen3.5-0.8B or Qwen3.5-2B, so the files come from unsloth, a quantizer that converts the official Qwen weights without changing them. Change a pin only with a new commit, size and SHA256 from the same listing.

models.source: Q4_K_M GGUF of Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B by unsloth. The base model card and LICENSE file say Apache-2.0, and the GGUF card links the same license. Qwen has no official GGUF of this model. Text only: the vision projector (mmproj) is not used.

Q4_K_M GGUF of Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B by unsloth. The base model card and LICENSE file say Apache-2.0, and the GGUF card links the same license. Qwen has no official GGUF of this model. Text only: the vision projector (mmproj) is not used.
